title: Quick Sugary Japanese Eggs Tamagoyaki
description: A traditional Japanese dish featuring sweet and springy eggs, perfect for a weeknight meal. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with sugar, salt, mirin, and soy sauce until the sugar is fully dissolved.
Heat the vegetable oil in a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of the egg mixture into the pan and tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook the egg for about 2 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the egg towards the center.
Pour a small amount of the remaining egg mixture over the folded egg and continue cooking for another minute.
Repeat the process of folding and adding more egg mixture until all the egg is used up.
Remove the tamagoyaki from the pan and let it cool on a plate.
Slice the tamagoyaki into small pieces and serve.
